attachments.installPolicy: Create nondeform helper with target hand rest @ referenceParentRelativeRest; recompute anchor from original target knuckles if body proportions differ. Preserve parent-relative animation deltas. Do not copy reference world positions.
attachments.weaponFramePolicy: Helpers retain authored KayKit socket axes. Apply prop authorToExport rotation inverse only; do not cancel its baked physical length.

limitations: Original free Ranger/Peasant sets are not heavy plate armor or exact v5 costume silhouettes.
Supplied long hair is reused with blonde tint; no new curl/bob/ponytail strand modelling.
Two supplied base faces are reused; bespoke v5 facial sculpting is not claimed.
Weapons and runtime native PBR/default part selection are integrated separately.
